c: While you can still sign in, open Password Reset Enrollment and register your mobile phone.
say: While you can still sign in, open password reset enrollment and register your mobile phone. It is not done for you.

c: On the Forgot password page, type your User name, fill in the Captcha and choose Next.
say: On the forgot password page, type your user name, fill in the captcha, and choose next.

c: Type your email address, then the 6-digit code sent to your phone, within 5 minutes.
say: Type your email address, then the six digit code sent to your phone, within five minutes. Both checks are required.

c: Open the Password Reset email within an hour and choose your new password.
say: You get an email called password reset. Open its link within an hour and choose your new password.

c: After 3 failed attempts you are blocked for 24 hours. Call the service desk.
say: After three failed attempts you are blocked for twenty four hours. Call the service desk instead.
